newsitem.title: USA: Heilig-Meyers sees q2 earnings under press.
newsitem.headline: Heilig-Meyers sees q2 earnings under press.

text.p: Furniture retailer Heilig-Meyers said on Wednesday that its second quarter earnings for the period ending August 31, 1997, would be "under pressure" because of a weak performance for the first two months of the quarter.

Troy Peery Jr., president and chief operating officer, said in a statement that July sales were soft, primarily in the company's Heilig-Meyers stores where sales of seasonal goods were particularly slow.
Peery said sales at the company's other formats, including Berrios and Mattress Discounters, were better than planned.
